system.description: An Ascendant-level power. The vampire spends half his current Blood Traits (rounded up) and succeeds at a Static Physical Challenge, bidding at least two Traits; Traits successfully risked determine how far into the past he may reach per a Storyteller chart. Success summons a past scene to overwrite the present within an area up to the size of a ballroom; only the wielder can interact meaningfully, others are insubstantial observers unless they possess Time Attunement. A permanent summons of a person or object costs one permanent Willpower Trait and cannot alter recorded or remembered history.
system.bloodCost: Half current Blood Traits, rounded up
